I feel like if we ignore this change (because we don't include SDL's filesystem subsystem) we can end up with a bug that would be hard to reproduce both for us and the developers of SDL (if we end up reporting it upstream). Would it be possible to replace the usage of SDL's filesystem subsystem here with a small custom implementation and check if it works?

Maybe we can also propose that custom implementation to SDL so other projects that only use SDL's joystick too can benefit from this change!
